title: Tenet's Secret: Your Future Is Already Written
hook: Forget time travel; what if your future is already decided?
script: Forget time travel; what if your future is already decided? This isn't just science fiction; it's a concept called the Block Universe. This theory suggests that past, present, and future all exist simultaneously, like every page of a book already written. We just perceive ourselves reading through it one moment at a time. The movie Tenet brilliantly explores this, not as changing the past, but experiencing events in reverse order, or 'inversion.' It challenges our understanding of cause and effect, suggesting they might just be a matter of perspective, driven by the universe's arrow of entropy. If time is a fixed dimension, then everything is already laid out. So, forget time travel; what if your future is already decided?
comment: If your future is already decided, would you want to know it?
description: Dive into the mind-bending science behind Tenet! Explore the Block Universe theory and why your future might be more fixed than you think. #Tenet #TimeTravel #BlockUniverse
